starting_checkpoint.optimizer_state: fresh AdamW, no saved optimizer state

all_other_classifier_rows: Frozen and bitwise checked, including washing machine, cat and dog
frozen_components: all backbone, transformer encoder/decoder and box-regressor parameters and buffers
all classifier rows except billboard row133 in the two specified heads

separate_training_region_overlay.supervision: Assistant-reviewed regulatory sign panels, billboard-negative queries at IoU>=.7 ONLY inside each panel; all outside scope remains unchanged/unknown

training.per_update: 1 billboard-positive +2 distinct explicitly absent +1 reviewed sign-region photo
training.gradient_clip: Joint L2 norm .1 across both active head parameter groups
training.model_mode: eval; main and encoder proposal billboard rows trainable
training.early_stop: At update 1500 stop if no eligible strict gain over the frozen new-run baseline has been selected. Otherwise continue to maximum 3000 updates.
training.validation_margin: Stop before the elapsed cap with sufficient margin for receipt/checkpoint finalization; a partial run is not a completed fixed-budget trial.
training.objective: Original scoped Hungarian IA-BCE main/aux/selected-encoder loss, plus dense encoder billboard IA-BCE weight1 on full proposal grid. One-to-one geometry Hungarian IoU>=.5 positives; absent/complete all-query negatives, unknown only positive matches/reviewed IoU>=.7 sign queries. Region penalty1 or3 on main/aux/selected and dense encoder classification.
training.dense_quality_target: Detached p^.25*IoU^.75, minimum.01, positive query matched by geometry only; dense coefficient2/max(1,billboard targets).

selection.guard: Each reviewed class individually: complete TP and partial hits cannot decrease; complete FP cannot increase versus BOTH selected job7805570 step100 and original job7780632 step0. Aggregate unscored predictions may rise at most5 versus EITHER baseline; unknown predictions are not false positives.
selection.ranking: Among eligible checkpoints, increase total reviewed-positive hits, then complete-scope F1; exact ties retain earlier step. Step0 remains selected if none improves.
selection.across_variants: After all four tasks terminal/audited select by predeclared validation ranking only, strict gain required, ties lower index. Known regression may veto adoption but never reselect. Failures preserved, no replacements.

evaluation.adoption: Regression retention and useful gain required. Additional independent frozen evidence is needed before making a new generalization claim. Preserve the existing numerical-export hold unless separately resolved; training does not fix ONNX numerical differences.
evaluation.limits: Small assistant-reviewed development and known regression sets; no fresh held-out accuracy claim.
evaluation.postprocessing: Freeze each validation-selected checkpoint hash before scoring all known references; no optimizer, no test-based reselection. A step-zero result reuses pinned current-model scores without inference.

extra_guard: Step0 must reproduce pinned current counts and retain original; all original per-class guards and aggregate unscored+5 against BOTH baselines retained.
strict_gain_definition: Eligible validation ranking must strictly beat current baseline; earlier checkpoint/lower array index wins exact ties. Any class can change through proposal selection, and each must pass both baselines.
limits: Development references are consumed, and repeated local comparisons add selection pressure; no fresh generalization claim.
Proposal coverage52/54 versus36/54 selected is training geometry evidence, not an accuracy guarantee.
Only two billboard classifier rows may update. Frozen regressor parameters do not imply unchanged box outputs.
Eight assistant-reviewed TRAIN sign panels add region-only negatives; original release scopes and labels remain preserved.
The existing ONNX numerical hold remains; production adoption is false.
approval_required_reason: User explicitly requires a pause before posting a new cluster job. Local diagnostics and package preparation do not authorize submission.
execution_package_status: Prepared locally, no approval, archive, SSH or submission

batch.task_failure_policy: Other array tasks continue; failed tasks are preserved, never replaced automatically.

local_autonomy: No extra user approval is needed for later local audit, export, CPU parity, reversible integration or packaging. Automatic_export=false means this cluster batch has no ONNX export stage; it is not a permission boundary.
rationale: Two encoder learning rates by two region penalties; frozen-selector controls run locally from exact cached features. Four GPU trials isolate this new proposal mechanism without repeating cacheable controls. Additional grid points would add selection pressure before showing this mechanism works.
parameter_invariance: Bitwise equality outside the two active rows. Changed proposal selection CAN change decoder features, box outputs and other detections; both-baseline retention remains mandatory.

local_controls.roles: Two main-head-only frozen-selector controls at region weights1/3, up to1500CPU updates. Dense encoder constant omitted because it has no main-head gradient.
